properties.name: x402.facilitators[].url
properties.description: Facilitator base URL. None configured = https://x402.org/facilitator.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].identifier
properties.description: Name used in logs, health and pins; defaults to the url (trailing slashes removed). "local" is reserved.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].timeout
properties.description: Settle and /supported timeout; must exceed the facilitator's confirmation wait.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].verify-timeout
properties.description: /verify timeout (Java); bounds the extra hop when failover is on.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].headers.verify
properties.description: Static headers for POST /verify.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].headers.settle
properties.description: Static headers for POST /settle.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].headers.supported
properties.description: Static headers for GET /supported.

properties.name: x402.facilitators[].auth-ref
properties.description: Bean name of an X402FacilitatorAuthProvider; replaces headers.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.network
properties.description: CAIP-2 network of the account (required), e.g. cardano:preprod. Account names match [a-z0-9-]+.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.pay-to
properties.description: Receiving address.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.pay-to-ref
properties.description: Bean name of an X402DynamicPayTo resolving the address per request.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.scheme
properties.description: Scheme for this account's options; else x402.defaults.scheme.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.max-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Payment timeout for this account's options; else x402.defaults.max-timeout-seconds.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.extra
properties.description: Scheme data merged under each option's extra (e.g. assetTransferMethod). Set from YAML, not plain env vars (keys are case-sensitive).

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.facilitator
properties.description: Pins every option of this account to a facilitator identifier.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.path
properties.description: x402 route pattern (syntax: *, :param, [param]; {var} is rejected) protecting matching requests without an annotation, e.g. "GET /report/*".

properties.name: x402.routes.*.description
properties.description: Resource description in PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.mime-type
properties.description: Response MIME type in PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.resource
properties.description: Fixed resource URL; default is the request URL.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.service-name
properties.description: Service name in PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.tags
properties.description: Discovery tags.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.icon-url
properties.description: Icon URL.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.custom-paywall-html
properties.description: Fixed HTML paywall page for browsers.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.failover
properties.description: Verify failover for unpinned options; absent inherits x402.defaults.failover.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.extensions
properties.description: Extension declarations, e.g. bazaar.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].account
properties.description: Account supplying network and receiver; not together with network.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].network
properties.description: Network of an inline option (no account); needs pay-to or pay-to-ref.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].scheme
properties.description: Scheme; else the account's, else x402.defaults.scheme.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].pay-to
properties.description: Receiving address; replaces the account's receiver.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].pay-to-ref
properties.description: Bean name of an X402DynamicPayTo.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].price
properties.description: Money string ("$0.50" = 0.50 of the network's default stablecoin, "0.50 USDM") or {amount, asset, extra} in atomic units. Not with price-ref.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].price.amount
properties.description: Amount in atomic units (object form).

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].price.asset
properties.description: Asset identifier (object form), e.g. lovelace.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].price.extra
properties.description: Asset data merged below the account's and option's extra.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].price-ref
properties.description: Bean name of an X402DynamicPrice evaluated per request.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].max-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Payment timeout.

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].extra
properties.description: Scheme data; wins over the account's (an inherited assetTransferMethod may not change).

properties.name: x402.routes.*.accepts[].facilitator
properties.description: Pins the option to a facilitator identifier.

properties.name: x402.client.spend-controls.allowed-assets[].network
properties.description: Network or pattern, e.g. cardano:*.

properties.name: x402.client.spend-controls.allowed-assets[].asset
properties.description: Asset identifier, e.g. lovelace.

properties.name: x402.client.spend-controls.allowed-assets[].max-amount-per-payment
properties.description: Cap in atomic units.

properties.name: x402.client.cardano.mnemonic
properties.description: Default wallet mnemonic for every Cardano network the client pays on; a network's own mnemonic overrides it.

properties.name: x402.client.cardano.networks[].network
properties.description: Cardano network, e.g. cardano:preprod.

properties.name: x402.client.cardano.networks[].mnemonic
properties.description: Per-network buyer mnemonic; else x402.client.cardano.mnemonic.

properties.name: x402.client.cardano.networks[].blockfrost.project-id
properties.description: Blockfrost project id for this network.

properties.name: x402.client.cardano.networks[].blockfrost.base-url
properties.description: Blockfrost base URL; defaults per network.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.l1-confirmations
properties.description: Confirmation depth -1..20 for this account's Cardano options; becomes extra.confirmationPolicy unless the option sets one.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.masumi.seller-mnemonic
properties.description: Signs Masumi quotes on the account's network; a CardanoSellerSigner bean wins. One value per network.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.masumi.seller-return-address
properties.description: Optional key-credential payout address for Masumi quotes on the network.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.masumi.agent-identifier
properties.description: Optional Masumi registry asset id signed into quotes on the network.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.masumi.deployment.required-admins
properties.description: Non-canonical Masumi escrow deployment: required admin signatures (required on Preview).

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.masumi.deployment.admin-vkeys
properties.description: Non-canonical Masumi escrow deployment: admin key hashes, in order.

properties.name: x402.accounts.*.cardano.masumi.deployment.cooldown-period
properties.description: Non-canonical Masumi escrow deployment: cooldown in ms.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].network
properties.description: Cardano network served by the facilitator, e.g. cardano:preprod.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].blockfrost.project-id
properties.description: Blockfrost project id for this network.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].blockfrost.base-url
properties.description: Blockfrost base URL; defaults per network.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].mnemonic
properties.description: Optional facilitator mnemonic (address shown in /supported); provider-only without it.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].slot-config.zero-time
properties.description: POSIX milliseconds of zero-slot; with zero-slot and slot-length, replaces the network's built-in slot configuration (e.g. a private testnet).

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].slot-config.zero-slot
properties.description: First slot of the slot configuration.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].slot-config.slot-length
properties.description: Milliseconds per slot.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].network-magic
properties.description: Genesis network magic the provider must report; defaults to the public network's (764824073, 1, 2).

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].evaluation
properties.description: Whether the provider offers transaction evaluation; false (e.g. yaci-store) skips verify's dry-run.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.networks[].masumi-allowed-script-hashes
properties.description: Masumi escrow script hashes (28-byte hex) accepted on the network; when set, every other escrow, the canonical one included, is refused.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.max-tx-bytes
properties.description: The largest transaction verify accepts, in bytes (at most 65536); the protocol's maxTxSize lowers it further.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.script-datum-policy
properties.description: How strictly a script payment's datum is checked: reference (refuses only a Plutus V1 inline datum), strict, or v3-optional.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.max-tip-age
properties.description: How far a provider's latest block may lag the wall clock before chain reads are refused.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.lookup-timeout
properties.description: Bound on the chain lookups of one verification; past it the verdict is chain_lookup_failed.

properties.name: x402.facilitator-server.cardano.max-input-lookups
properties.description: How many inputs one verification resolves on chain; a transaction with more is chain_lookup_failed.
